answer: Peer-prediction pay: each grader's reward is scored against a hidden random co-grader, so a lantern-bright fake ring only earns if it matches honest graders. Pairing 5 random peers per answer, a ring of N fakes must outvote honest tide-level majorities, costing roughly N times 5 matches. Weakness: a quill-thin honest pool lets colluders dominate pairings.
